notes: Two fixes from the first 0.1.13 session on the phone. Backing out of the app and reopening it no longer gives a blank screen with Address already in use: the engine now releases port 8080 when the app closes. Live view no longer fails with HTTP 409 when the camera thinks a stream is still running; the app stops it and tries once more. Next step: on the Camera step tap Apply camera settings and check the panel reads 1080p, 240 fps, Linear, HyperSmooth Off.
